observations: Looked at assets/panels/04-3.png with Read (its hash in the request is 2238f4e3...). Ananya faces screen-right toward Ravi with a closed-mouth soft smile, gentle eye contact and small nod marks beside her head, which fits 'listening, mid-nod'. The almond eyes with heavy lids, level brows, oval face, low bun, gold stud, white coat, teal kurta and stethoscope (not in use) match main-cast.png.
Right foreground: the back of Ravi's head, his beard edge and his green-shirt shoulder. This keeps Ananya-left / Ravi-right from 04-1. A closed laptop corner sits at the lower left of the desk.

Hand evidence: faces visible. Both hands lie on the desk and show their backs; I see no palm surface or palm creases. The upper hand (about x 355-500, y 860-935) shows a knuckle line and dorsal surface. Its fingers run toward screen-right and curl down at the screen-right end (fingertips about x 470-500, y 900-935), resting on the lower hand and wrist. The lower hand (about x 365-480, y 925-982) shows a row of curled fingers whose tips point screen-left and down (about x 365-440, y 940-980).

Hand evidence: forearm paths. Because she faces screen-right, her right shoulder is on screen-left and her left shoulder on screen-right. The screen-left sleeve cuff (about x 200-330, y 900-975) carries a forearm rightward into the screen-left end of the upper hand, which is where that hand's wrist must be, since its fingers point the other way. The screen-right sleeve cuff (about x 540-620, y 880-960) carries a forearm leftward into the screen-right end of the lower hand, where its wrist must be, since its fingers point screen-left. On this reading her right hand is on top and her left hand underneath. That matches the current record: right 'folded over the left hand ... forearm enters from screen-left', left 'folded under the right hand ... forearm enters from screen-right'.

Limits of this evidence: I saw the panel only at full-panel scale (no 200% crop tool). The upper hand's thumb is not clearly separable at this scale, so I base ownership on finger direction plus the wrist-to-sleeve paths, not on the thumb. The screen-right cuff sits slightly higher than the screen-left cuff. That is the probable source of the r2 reading that the upper hand comes from screen-right. Even so, the upper hand's fingertips, not its wrist, lie at the screen-right end, which contradicts that reading.

Conflict status: my independent reading agrees with r3 (right over left) and with the current record. The r2 reading (left over right) is the outlier. This settles a review judgement, not an image edit: the image is unchanged in this respect, and the record was corrected. The new response should keep r2's answer and save this reasoning, as docs/ART-QUALITY.md requires. Hand order carries no story meaning.
